description: Defines the ProxyServer class which encodes proxy server type, host, and port, including methods for creation, validation, and property checks. Contains enum for proxy schemes and related utility functions.

classes.name: ProxyServer
classes.description: Immutable class representing a proxy server with scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: ProxyServer
methods.description: Default constructor, creates an invalid ProxyServer.

methods.name: ProxyServer(Scheme scheme, const HostPortPair& host_port_pair)
methods.description: Constructor with scheme and host/port pair.

methods.name: FromSchemeHostAndPort
methods.description: Creates a ProxyServer from scheme, host, and port string or optional port.

methods.name: GetHost
methods.description: Returns the host as a string.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the proxy server is valid.

methods.name: scheme
methods.description: Returns the scheme of the proxy.

methods.name: is_direct
methods.description: Checks if the proxy is a direct connection.

methods.name: is_http
methods.description: Checks if the proxy is an HTTP proxy.

methods.name: is_https
methods.description: Checks if the proxy is an HTTPS proxy.

methods.name: is_socks
methods.description: Checks if the proxy is a SOCKS proxy.

methods.name: is_quic
methods.description: Checks if the proxy is a QUIC proxy.

methods.name: is_http_like
methods.description: Checks if the proxy uses HTTP-like protocols.

methods.name: is_secure_http_like
methods.description: Checks if the proxy has secure HTTP semantics.

methods.name: host_port_pair
methods.description: Returns the host and port pair.

methods.name: Direct
methods.description: Returns a ProxyServer representing a direct connection.

methods.name: GetDefaultPortForScheme
methods.description: Returns default port for a given scheme.
